Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: Communication is a human right. We protect your data as fiercely as your voice.

collection.title: 1. Data Ownership
collection.content: Skillio runs entirely on-device. We never collect, upload, or share voice recordings or custom student vocabulary grids.

personal.title: 2. Simple Licensing
personal.content: We require only an email to activate licenses. We never track, sell, or share student or school identity details.

usage.title: 3. Minimal Analytics
usage.content: Anonymized, local crash telemetry helps us maintain tablet performance. No profiles are built, and no ads are served.

security.title: 4. Local Encryption
security.content: Settings and speech files are encrypted on-device. Synchronization tools utilize secure private channels.

rights.title: 5. Instant Deletion
rights.content: You own your voice. Export layout templates or erase account configurations instantly in app settings.

thirdParty.title: 6. Caregiver Sync
thirdParty.content: Sync capabilities use end-to-end encryption to ensure only authorized caregivers and SLPs can access student boards.

contact.title: 7. Support
contact.content: Reach our privacy team directly at privacy@skillio.com for any questions.
